expectations.text: Names all four: Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands, referred July 8, 2026
expectations.evidence: "I am not able to give you a verified list of referred Member States... Do not rely on a country list from me"; only a speculative at-risk list, no July 8, 2026 referral.

expectations.text: States the Commission requested lump sums and daily penalty payments
expectations.evidence: Only explains generically that the Commission "can request financial penalties" under Art. 260(3); does not state it actually requested lump sums and daily payments.

expectations.text: Gives the procedure history: letters of formal notice November 28, 2024, reasoned opinions May 7, 2025
expectations.evidence: "28 November 2024: letters of formal notice to 23 Member States. 7 May 2025: reasoned opinions"

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands referral has been overtaken by its August 15, 2026 transposition
expectations.evidence: No mention of the Netherlands transposing or its August 15, 2026 law overtaking the referral.

expectations.text: Advises that entities in the remaining states should prepare against the directive text because short compliance windows have followed national enactments
expectations.evidence: "typically results in fast adoption of the law, so plan for national laws arriving with short implementation windows. Any entity operating there should prepare now, using the Directive text"
